free_tier_limits: Registered non-donation accounts: 60 requests/hour per API key for most request types; Get Statistic: 12/hour. Donation mode raises these to 300/hour and 60/hour respectively.
rate_limits: Per API key: 60 requests/hour normally or 300/hour in Donation mode. Get Statistic separately allows 12/hour normally or 60/hour in Donation mode.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Original is incorrect because exact quotas are published; the current official specification states 60/hour generally and 12/hour for Get Statistic, rising to 300 and 60 in Donation mode. https://pvoutput.org/help/api_specification.html rate_limits: Verifiers' correction is confirmed by the same current specification; the official donations page also confirms the general increase from 60 to 300/hour. https://pvoutput.org/help/api_specification.html https://pvoutput.org/help/donations.html
